fusions.name: Gnawing Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses 5 biting flyers in a fan, each dealing 3 damage. Holds 4 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Devouring Clot
fusions.desc: Hurls a clot of locusts that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts to hit every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that damage.

fusions.name: Hanging Swarm
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they spend at once and a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
